notes.wasuze-otya: Abangereza tebabuuza nti wasuze otya. Bagamba “Good morning” okutuusa mu ttuntu.
notes.osiibye-otya: “Good afternoon” okuva mu ttuntu, ate “Good evening” akawungeezi.
notes.gyebale-ko: Mu Lungereza lwa Uganda, “Well done” kye kigambo ky’ogamba omuntu akola.
notes.nze: Mu Lungereza “I” bulijjo kiwandiikibwa n’ennukuta ennene, ne wakati mu sentensi.
notes.ggwe: “You” kye kimu, ka obe ng’oyogera n’omuntu omu oba n’abangi.
notes.ndi: “I am” bangi bakimpimpisa nga “I’m”. Byombi bituufu.

guidebook.intro: Mu Lungereza okulamusa kumpi: “Hello” oba “Good morning”, “How are you?”, “I’m fine, thank you.” Ekitundu kino kikuyigiriza okulamusa, okweyanjula n’okubala okutuuka ku kkumi.

tips.title: Okulamusa kugoberera essaawa
body: Okutuusa mu ttuntu gamba **Good morning**. Okuva mu ttuntu okutuuka akawungeezi, **Good afternoon**. Akawungeezi n’ekiro, **Good evening**.
**How are you?** kikola essaawa yonna. Okuddamu okwa bulijjo kwe **I’m fine, thank you.**

tips.title: “I” ne “I am”
body: Mu Luganda “nze” n’ekikolwa bigattibwa: **ndi** kitegeeza “I am”. Mu Lungereza ebigambo biba bibiri: **I** (nze) ne **am** (ndi).
**I** bulijjo kiwandiikibwa n’ennukuta ennene. **I am** bangi bakimpimpisa nga **I’m**.

tips.title: “You” ku muntu omu n’abangi
body: Mu Luganda ogamba **Weebale** eri omuntu omu ne **Mwebale** eri abangi. Mu Lungereza **Thank you** kye kimu ku bombi, era **you** kye kimu ku muntu omu n’abangi.

culture.title: Olungereza mu Uganda
body: Olungereza lwe lulimi lw’eggwanga mu Uganda. Lukozesebwa mu masomero, mu ofiisi, mu kkooti ne mu mawulire, era lwe luyunga abantu aboogera ennimi ez’enjawulo.

culture.title: Okulamusa okumpi
body: Aboogera Olungereza batera okulamusa mu bigambo bitono: **Hi!** oba **Hello!** Si bubi; bwe batyo bwe bakola. Mu Uganda, abantu era bagamba **Well done** eri omuntu akola, nga Gyebale ko.
